about: Reviewed rewordings for PoE1 item lines (ADR-015 Amendment 3; docs/phase-6/item-rewordings.md). A line no stat description reads is tried here after the other tolerances: its template (each number, or each range written (a-b), as #) is looked up in `accepted`, and the line is read again in the current wording with the same numbers in the same order, carrying the tolerance `reworded`. A pair is accepted only when PoB v2.67.2 parses both wordings, at the same numbers, into identical mods with no text left over (`loom-parity-cli item-rewordings check`, maintainer-run with the oracle) and a review finds the change one of wording alone. `rejected` records the pairs looked at and why each was not accepted; a rejected or unlisted line stays `no-template`.

accepted.old: +# to Maximum Endurance Charge
accepted.why: The game prints the plural for every value now (max_endurance_charges has one variant); PoB: EnduranceChargesMax BASE for both.

accepted.old: +# to Maximum Frenzy Charge
accepted.why: As above, max_frenzy_charges; PoB: FrenzyChargesMax BASE for both.

accepted.old: +# to Maximum Power Charge
accepted.why: As above, max_power_charges; PoB: PowerChargesMax BASE for both.

accepted.old: #% increased Charges used
accepted.why: A flask's local_charges_used_+%; "used" became "per use". PoB: FlaskChargesUsed INC for both.

accepted.old: #% reduced Charges used
accepted.why: As above, the negative form.

accepted.old: +#% to Critical Strike Multiplier for Spells
accepted.current: +#% to Critical Strike Multiplier for Spell Damage
accepted.why: base_spell_critical_strike_multiplier_+; "Spells" became "Spell Damage". PoB: CritMultiplier BASE with the Spell flag for both.

accepted.old: Chaos Damage does not bypass Energy Shield
accepted.current: Chaos Damage taken does not bypass Energy Shield
accepted.why: "taken" added to the wording. PoB: ChaosNotBypassEnergyShield FLAG for both. Two descriptions print the current text; the item's mods choose, as for any line.

accepted.old: #% increased Attack Speed during Flask effect
accepted.why: A flask's local_flask_attack_speed_+%_while_healing; 3.15 shortened "during Flask effect" to "during Effect" on flasks. PoB: Speed INC, Attack, while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: #% reduced Attack Speed during Flask effect
accepted.why: As above, the negative form.

accepted.old: #% increased Stun Recovery
accepted.why: stun_recovery_+%: one stat for stun and block recovery, "and Block" added to the wording. PoB: StunRecovery INC for both.

accepted.old: #% reduced Stun Recovery
accepted.why: As above, the negative form.

accepted.old: +# Life gained for each Enemy hit by your Attacks
accepted.current: Gain # Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks
accepted.why: life_gain_per_target; the old "+# Life gained for each Enemy hit by your Attacks" became "Gain # Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks". PoB: LifeOnHit BASE with the Attack flag for both.

accepted.old: #% increased Cooldown Recovery
accepted.why: base_cooldown_speed_+%; "Rate" added to the wording. PoB: CooldownRecovery INC for both.

accepted.old: #% reduced Cooldown Recovery
accepted.why: As above, the negative form.

accepted.old: #% increased Movement Speed during Flask effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: MovementSpeed INC while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: #% increased Area of Effect during Flask Effect
accepted.current: #% increased Area of Effect during Effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: AreaOfEffect INC while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: #% increased Damage Over Time during Flask Effect
accepted.current: #% increased Damage Over Time during Effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: Damage INC with the Dot flag while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: #% reduced Damage Over Time during Flask Effect
accepted.current: #% reduced Damage Over Time during Effect
accepted.why: As above, the negative form.

accepted.old: Skills fire # additional Projectiles during Flask Effect
accepted.current: Skills fire # additional Projectiles during Effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: ProjectileCount BASE while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: Grants Level # Despair Curse Aura during Flask Effect
accepted.current: Grants Level # Despair Curse Aura during Effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: the same ExtraCurse of Despair while UsingFlask for both.

accepted.old: #% of Chaos Damage Leeched as Life during Flask effect
accepted.current: #% of Chaos Damage Leeched as Life during Effect
accepted.why: a flask's "during Flask effect" became "during Effect" (as the accepted Attack Speed pair). PoB: ChaosDamageLifeLeech BASE while UsingFlask for both.

rejected.current: #% increased Mana Reservation Efficiency of Skills
rejected.why: A mechanic change, not a wording (3.16: reservation became reservation efficiency); PoB parses them into different mods (ManaReserved against ManaReservationEfficiency).

rejected.old: #% increased Mana Cost Efficiency of Attacks
rejected.why: A mechanic change: the current stat covers every cost, not mana only; PoB parses them into different mods (ManaCostEfficiency against CostEfficiency).

rejected.old: Projectiles cannot collide with Enemies at Close Range
rejected.current: Projectiles cannot collide with Enemies in Close Range
rejected.why: PoB parses neither wording, so its parse is no evidence for the pair.

rejected.old: #% of Damage from Hits is taken from your Spectres' Life before you
rejected.current: #% of Damage from Hits is taken from your Raised Spectres' Life before you
rejected.why: PoB parses only the old wording (takenFromSpectresBeforeYou); the current one it does not read, so the two parses differ.

rejected.old: Wave of Conviction's Exposure applies -#% Elemental Resistance
rejected.current: Wave of Conviction's Exposure applies an extra -#% to Elemental Resistance
rejected.why: PoB reads both as the same skill stat (purge_expose_resist_%_matching_highest_element_damage), but the game's current line is another stat (purge_additional_enemy_resistance_%, "an extra"): same numbers, not shown to be the same mechanic.

rejected.old: Trigger Level # Assassin's Mark when you Hit a Rare or Unique Enemy
rejected.current: Trigger Level # Assassin's Mark when you Hit a Rare or Unique Enemy and have no Mark
rejected.why: The current wording adds a condition ("and have no Mark"): not shown to be a change of wording alone.

rejected.old: Trigger Level # Poacher's Mark when you Hit a Rare or Unique Enemy
rejected.current: Trigger Level # Poacher's Mark when you Hit a Rare or Unique Enemy and have no Mark

rejected.why: PoB parses only the current wording (LifeOnKill BASE); the old "+# Life gained on Kill" leaves text over in PoB, so it applies nothing and there is no evidence the two read the same.
